title: Behavior is a selection pressure, like the environment

statements.text: An animal's behavior changes which inherited traits are favored, as its environment does. A drive to attack in the common ancestor of the Carnivora may have shaped its descendants, and a mutation for better swimming does little for an animal that avoids water.

sources.quote: That ancestor may have had an inherited drive to attack, which could have shaped the evolution of its descendants
a mutation that lets you swim better is not very useful to those who hate water.
